about.title: Beyond Clicks, Focused on
about.text: I’m a Digital Marketing professional with 1+ year of experience in performance marketing, paid advertising, SEO, social media marketing, and online reputation management. I have hands-on experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, analyzing campaign performance, and identifying opportunities for optimization.
